slug: 2025-11-16 Kenyans shunning locally-made smartphones over quality concerns

facts.fact: Citizen Digital reports that Kenya's first smartphone assembly plant opened in Machakos in October 2023 (East Africa Device Assembly Kenya Ltd), and that 268,000 locally-assembled phones had been bought by April 2024.
facts.system: East Africa Device Assembly Kenya Ltd plant, Machakos

facts.fact: Citizen Digital reports M-Kopa said it had produced more than 1.5 million phones at its Nairobi factory by November 2024.
